title: MOASYS-Vault — shows.json
description: The shows catalog. One entry per show; each show carries its seasons; each season carries its per-episode rows. Generated by `npm run shows`.

edition.description: Plex TV Show Editions tag off the show folder ('Show (2026) {edition-True Hue Color}'), or null when untagged. Editions of one series are separate entries — Plex tracks their watch state separately.

season.description: Numeric label ('1', '2', '10') or named season ('Specials', 'Champion of Champions').

episode_count.description: Total episodes across this season's files. Multi-episode files (S01E01-E02) count as 2.

episodes.description: One entry per episode file on disk. Single-episode files have episode_start === episode_end.

episode_end.description: Equal to episode_start for single-episode files.

title.description: Trailing '- Episode Title' portion from the filename, or null when omitted.
